title: Cast Image Studio character registry
authority: Machine-readable authority for every character this skill may draw: ids, reference sheets, SHA-256 hashes, looks, drawn ratios, prompt blocks and negatives. Read a character's prompt_block verbatim into the generation prompt; never describe a registered character from memory and never paraphrase a negative.
usage_rules: There is no default protagonist. A character appears in an image only when the frozen cast names it.
A character reference controls identity only. It never controls style, costume, background, pose, crop, composition or text; those come from the request and from art_direction.
Art-style consistency comes from the frozen art_direction contract, not from any character's sheet. Every character is drawn in the register and style that contract states.
drawn_ratio is a planning hint for relative height inside a cast. It is never a QA target and never overrides the frozen register.
One reference image per character per image task is enough, and only for characters that are physically in frame or drawn as an avatar.
Declare a character reference with the character's id as the reference id; identity is always one of its roles.
The master images are the user's original files (or the bundled canonical master for Whale-chan), stored byte-for-byte. Their hashes are frozen: do not re-encode, re-compress or upscale them.

ratio_authority.note: drawn_ratio is the character's own design ratio, recorded and used only to plan relative height inside a cast. It is never a QA target: the frozen register is the only proportion target, and every character is redrawn at that register. A cast that mixes registers records one register per character and states the intended relative height in the scene instead of pretending one register fits all.
ratio_authority.source: note-graded from the single supplied sheet's pixel landmarks, or the bundled semi-chibi master for Whale-chan
ratio_authority.confidence_low: sheet was cluttered or the chin/sole landmarks were partially hidden
ratio_authority.confidence_high: clean full-body sheet with an unobstructed chin and sole line

registers.mature: standard adult anime register: roughly 6-8 heads, full-length limbs, adult face construction
registers.compact: compact register: roughly 4.5-6 heads, shorter limbs, simplified but still adult-shaped face
registers.chibi: chibi-adjacent register: roughly 2.5-3.5 heads, very large head, short rounded body, small feet

proportion_policy_values.as-drawn: the character's own design is already close to the frozen register; scale only
proportion_policy_values.redraw: keep identity, redesign scale: redraw limbs and torso at the frozen register
proportion_policy_values.mature: keep the character's adult apparent age; never turn an adult character into a child

characters.personality: Tsundere, and a sore loser who cannot admit defeat. Warm her up first: a small proud smile, a flustered pout, cheeks puffed, looking away, arms crossed, a half-hidden smile she is trying to swallow. She never becomes mean, never turns genuinely angry and never glares with hostility. Play every setback as cute fluster, not as cruelty.
